title: HHHusher (v2)
description: Studio-gear calm in flat bands: cream pages, near-black and bronze-tan bands, and one signal yellow for every buy button, active tab and star. A medium-weight neo-grotesk at big sizes, bold monospaced caps for labels and buttons, 5px corners, no shadows.
notes: light (cream) is the faithful mode; the hhhusher-v2 dark bands force themselves dark with the dark class, and the tan bands use secondary
Hanken Grotesk stands in for Universal Sans Display (closed) and, at 900, for Aeonik Black; Geist Mono for Aeonik Fono (closed)
gutter and section padding grow at 1024px (a media query in this file), as the original's do
